changes: Windows environment reads and writes scoped to the installer process. Dedicated HermesHome and InstallDir. Shared Git configuration and upstream shortcut creation disabled. System package managers disabled; optional ripgrep/ffmpeg use existing binaries without modification. uv provisioning uses an unmanaged candidate directory with shell/PATH modification disabled; child PowerShell does not load personal profiles. Portable Node failure cannot invoke a system installer. Pinned uv 0.12.12 archive with SHA256 verification. Frozen Python and voice dependency locks. Shallow pinned Git fetch. Deduplicated process PATH. No shared task or image-name process termination. Browser and TUI stages also use npm ci so no earlier stage can mutate the pinned dependency lock.
